palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed yellow body, purple forearms, white chest fur and paws, blue source eyes with dark pupil separation, facial markings, and black outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr391 mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded with fixed row-47 shadow. Preserve native lift and recoil; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own alternating long-leg travel cycle; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward kick and recovery; the source-native contact silhouette remains legible from side and diagonal views.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own two-hand gathering and upward release gesture; no invented projectile, glow, or effect.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own bowed, arms-crossed resting loop; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary backward recoil. Inverted bd02 and bd03 remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own broad arm-and-body strike. The fully inverted bs01 tumble is excluded; no synthetic weapon is added.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the own kick; one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own launch, airborne tuck, and landing; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced arm-gathering and release-ready cycle; no aura is invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
